data.narrative:
Glimpse is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $17M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of nine same-sector peers spanning one public company (LNZA) and eight private entities including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with tight valuation alignment to support a reliable median-based approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression analysis is the applicable method. Using total raised ($17M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $34M. This reflects the standard dilution and value-creation arc expected between rounds in the sector.

The triangulated range is $29M (low) to $39M (high), with $34M as the central estimate. The material uncertainty here stems from the absence of tight peer multiples; a more granular valuation would require either (i) comparable transaction data from same-stage Climate & Energy deals, or (ii) closer operational metrics (revenue, burn rate, customer concentration) on Glimpse itself. The $34M midpoint should be treated as a stage-based floor rather than a high-confidence point estimate.
